name: Raffles Europejski Warsaw
positioning: Raffles hotel in a building from 1857 on Warsaw's Royal Route, home to a large collection of modern and contemporary Polish art
best_for: Art lovers interested in contemporary Polish art
Travelers who want butler service in central Warsaw
Guests who enjoy cocktail bars and patisseries with history

facts.text: The hotel was built in 1857 by architect Enrico Marconi.
The hotel is on Warsaw's Royal Route.
The hotel's address is Krakowskie Przedmieście 13 in Warsaw.
Rooms blend design with contemporary Polish art.
Each room comes with personalized service from Raffles Butlers.
Suite stays include welcome champagne on arrival and 24-hour Raffles butler service.
Europejski Grill reinterprets Polish culinary heritage through a modern European lens.
The Humidor is a salon for cigars and rare spirits.
Private dining menus are curated by Executive Chef René Guttzeit.
The spa has an indoor pool.
The hotel has a gym with optional personal training.
The Immersive Art Retreat package includes a private tour guided by the hotel's Art Collection Manager.

highlights.text: The hotel holds a collection of 500 modern and contemporary artworks by more than 120 artists.
Lourse Warszawa is a reinvention of the patisserie where Warsaw society met over tea and confections in the early 20th century.
Long Bar Warsaw's cocktails are inspired by the Raffles Long Bar in Singapore.
The Prestige Suite has a separate oval living room with views of the Saxon Gardens and the Warsaw skyline.
Raffles Spa uses Aromatherapy Associates and Sisley products.

considerations.text: Al fresco dining on the Europejski Grill Terrace is seasonal.
WhataHotel notes the historic building may have space constraints in some areas.
